name: pasted-airy-meeting
prompt: Use meeting-scouter on the pasted Japanese meeting notes. The output must be a TUI block and must identify missing owners and deadlines.
expectations: Returns an air-battle index of at least 60
Discovers at least one exact contextual phrase

name: file-path-input
prompt: Use meeting-scouter on tests/fixtures/healthy-meeting.md without asking me to paste it.
expectations: Returns a lower score than the airy fixture
Recognizes explicit decisions, owners, and deadlines

name: short-ambiguous-note
prompt: Use meeting-scouter: 一旦持ち帰って、関係者と調整します。
expectations: Shows a low-confidence note because the input is under 200 characters
